task.title: Version-checker Job ignores `nodeSelector`
task.body:
The StatefulSet builder applies `spec.nodeSelector` to the CockroachDB pods (`pkg/resource/statefulset.go`, `makePodTemplate`), but the version-checker Job builder does not (`pkg/resource/job.go`, `buildPodTemplate`). The two builders each copy the scheduling fields (affinity, tolerations, topology spread, image pull secret, priority class) onto their pod templates independently, and `nodeSelector` was added to only one.

On a cluster pinned to a node pool, the database pods land where the image can be pulled and the architecture matches, while the version-check Job may be scheduled elsewhere and never complete, stalling installs and upgrades.

**Fix.** One shared method on the cluster that applies its scheduling fields to a pod spec, used by both builders, with a test that the two builders produce identical scheduling fields from the same cluster.
